parameters.excerpt: The EEI will define whether the memory system is little-endian or big-endian.
parameters.reasoning: The execution environment / implementation defines whether the memory system operates in little-endian or big-endian mode.

parameters.excerpt: loads and stores that are not naturally aligned may either complete execution successfully or raise an exception.
parameters.reasoning: The specification explicitly leaves support for misaligned loads and stores implementation-defined; an implementation may support them directly/successfully or raise an exception.
